channel.title: Worcester Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: Clark University climbs 14 spots on Fortune’s best MBA list
item.description: Clark was the sole Central Massachusetts university to make Fortune’s list.

item.title: 🔒 Medtronic’s R&D site in Boxborough sold for $17.8M to Boston firm
item.description: Completed in 2002, the two-story building is leased to Medtronic, an Ireland-headquartered medical device company.

item.title: 🔒 Aspen Aerogels’ net loss hit $390M in 2025
item.description: Aspen cites a drop in electric vehicle demand and production as catalysts for its major net loss of 2025.

item.title: EcoTarium expects elephant exhibit in new 6,400-sq.-ft. hall to attract 100K visitors
item.description: The hall will host “Secret World of Elephants,” a science exhibition developed by the American Museum of Natural History in New York City.

item.title: Open Sky appoints new director of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging
item.description: In his new role, Ekstrom will work to sustain Open Sky’s commitment to inclusivity, collaborating with fellow agency leaders to execute DEIB strategies throughout the organization.

item.title: Senate approves $3.28B borrowing bill for Mass. public higher education
item.description: Public higher education campuses around Massachusetts are on the verge of what boosters call the most significant capital investment in nearly two decades.

item.title: 🔒 Leominster firm acquires Toronto wire and cable company
item.description: Genuine Cable Group, a Chicago-based wire, cable, connectivity provider with a location in Leominster, has added a Canadian company to its portfolio.

item.title: Whitin Community Center breaks ground on child care center, part of $10M campaign
item.description: With WCC already serving 237 children across four sites and maintaining a growing waitlist, the new site aims to increase access to child care services in the Northbridge region.

item.title: MassDevelopment brings on new head of real estate
item.description: She joins the agency from MURAL Real Estate Partners, a New York City firm focused on mixed-income, mixed-use development

item.title: 🔒 Worcester nonprofit hopes new documentary fuels funding and awareness
item.description: Safe Exit Initiative is set to be featured in a new documentary the Worcester organization hopes will generate more funding as it expands into more states.
